description: 8B delay-pattern dialogue TTS: speaker-tagged conversation in one take, with per-speaker zero-shot voice cloning. 24 kHz, 16 codebooks.

request.name: voice_samples
request.description: Per-speaker reference WAV paths, comma separated and positional: the first is [S1], the second [S2]. Leave an entry empty to let that speaker be invented rather than cloned. Cannot be combined with voice_ref.

request.name: reference_text
request.description: What the reference recordings say, speaker-tagged. Prepended to the dialogue so the continuation carries on from words it has already spoken.

request.name: language
request.description: Full language name; the model does not understand codes like 'en'.

request.name: seed
request.description: Reproduces a take exactly. Parsed as signed 32-bit integer then converted to uint32; negative values wrap.

request.name: text_temperature
request.description: Text-token sampling temperature. Must be finite and positive when sampling.

request.name: temperature
request.description: Audio sampling temperature; must be > 0, default 1.5.

request.name: top_k
request.description: Audio top-k. Nonpositive values disable filtering.

request.name: repetition_penalty
request.description: Audio repetition penalty; must be > 0. Checked when token history is present; default 1.1.

request.name: max_frames
request.description: Ceiling on generated codec frames at 12.5/s; 0 derives one from the dialogue length. Nonpositive values derive an automatic ceiling.

session.name: weight_type
session.description: Backbone and head weight storage; default native, which keeps a GGUF package's own type. Forcing bf16 dequantises a quantised package and costs the VRAM the quantisation was meant to save. f16 is rejected: this backbone produces NaN in it.

description.en: 8B delay-pattern dialogue TTS: speaker-tagged conversation in one take, with per-speaker zero-shot voice cloning. 24 kHz, 16 codebooks.
description.zh: 8B 延迟模式对话 TTS：一次生成带说话人标记的对话，并支持逐说话人零样本音色克隆；24 kHz、16 个码本。

voice_samples.en: Per-speaker reference WAV paths, comma separated and positional: the first is [S1], the second [S2]. Leave an entry empty to let that speaker be invented rather than cloned. Cannot be combined with voice_ref.
voice_samples.zh: 逐说话人参考 WAV 路径，逗号分隔且按位置对应：第一个为 [S1]，第二个为 [S2]。留空表示让该说话人由模型生成而非克隆。不能与 voice_ref 同时使用。

reference_text.en: What the reference recordings say, speaker-tagged. Prepended to the dialogue so the continuation carries on from words it has already spoken.
reference_text.zh: 参考录音对应的内容，带说话人标记。会前置到对话中，使续写从已说过的词继续。

language.en: Full language name; the model does not understand codes like 'en'.
language.zh: 完整语言名称；模型不识别 'en' 这类代码。

instruct.zh: 对表达方式的自由文本指令。

seed.en: Reproduces a take exactly. Parsed as signed 32-bit integer then converted to uint32; negative values wrap.
seed.zh: 精确复现一次 take。按有符号 32 位整数解析后转换为 uint32；负值会回绕。

text_temperature.en: Text-token sampling temperature. Must be finite and positive when sampling.
text_temperature.zh: 文本 token 采样温度。采样时必须为有限正数。

temperature.en: Audio sampling temperature; must be > 0, default 1.5.
temperature.zh: 音频采样温度；必须 > 0，默认 1.5。

top_k.en: Audio top-k. Nonpositive values disable filtering.
top_k.zh: 音频 top-k。非正值关闭过滤。

repetition_penalty.en: Audio repetition penalty; must be > 0. Checked when token history is present; default 1.1.
repetition_penalty.zh: 音频重复惩罚；必须 > 0。存在 token 历史时检查；默认 1.1。

max_frames.en: Ceiling on generated codec frames at 12.5/s; 0 derives one from the dialogue length. Nonpositive values derive an automatic ceiling.
max_frames.zh: 生成 codec 帧上限（12.5 帧/秒）；0 表示按对话长度推导。非正值自动推导上限。
